name: Mutsumi
source:
Member of the school newspaper club of Rindoukan Academy, and friend of [url=/c89920]Usagawa Yukiko[/url].
She is the most sedate of the three, but blurts out everything she wants to say, so she is the most sarcastic in some sense?
